quests.title: The Starforge Tool
quests.description: You came to Hearthglow answering Odessa's notice for a builder. She has trusted you with the Starforge Tool: gather some materials and Spark Energy to wake it up.

objectives.text: Chop 3 wood from a tree with a pink ribbon (on the slope beside the village gate)
Catch a floating magic fragment
Show Odessa what you found

offer: Oh! A traveller! We hardly see a soul since the bridge fell. And dusty boots… you must have come about my notice. Builder wanted?
Then welcome to Hearthglow, {name}! I'm Odessa Quill. I built half the things you can see, once upon a time. These days the village is a little tired, and so are my hands.
Room and board, as promised: you'll stay at the Lantern Inn, the blue-roofed house south-east of the square. Rest there whenever you like.
Now, the real reason I sent for a builder. This is the Starforge Tool. It builds anything you can imagine, if you feed it materials and Spark Energy.
Let's wake it up. See the trees with pink ribbons, on the slope just past this gate? I marked the ones that are ready for cutting. Chop a little wood, then catch one of those floating fragments.
accept: Wonderful! Walk up to a ribboned tree and give it a good chop. The fragments only show themselves to the tool, so they'll appear now. They sparkle purple, you can't miss them.
decline: Take your time. The village has waited years; it can wait another minute.
progress: Wood from a ribboned tree, a fragment from the air. Then come back and show me!
complete: Look at that, the tool is humming! It likes you.
Now, your first real job. Fern the gardener has been fretting about her orchard bridge all week. She's in her garden, north of the square.
Do good work and folk will want you to stay. Who knows, maybe one day you'll have a home of your own here.

quests.title: Repair the Orchard Bridge
quests.description: The old bridge to Fern's orchard collapsed into the river. Build a new one that people can actually walk across.

objectives.text: Gather 6 more wood
Gather 5 Spark Energy (chop, mine, pick, catch fragments)
Build a walkable bridge to the orchard (B at the bridge site)
Tell Fern the bridge is ready

offer: Oh! You're the new builder? Thank goodness! It's an emergency. A gardening emergency!
My orchard is just across the river, but the bridge fell in ages ago. The apple trees haven't had a visitor in years.
Could you build a new bridge? Planks can stretch two tiles over the water — after that they need a post underneath.
accept: Hooray! I've sketched where it could go — you'll see my plan glowing at the bridge site. But build it however you like!
Here's some wood to start. You'll need a bit more, and some Spark Energy too.
decline: That's alright. The trees are patient. Mostly.
progress: Remember: planks reach two tiles from the bank or from a post. Build from both banks if you need to!
complete: You did it! A real bridge! I can hear the apple trees cheering. That's the rustling. Definitely cheering.
Here — my best flower-bed design, and a young tree pattern. Plant beauty everywhere!

quests.title: Furnish the Workshop
quests.description: Bram's workshop is empty and dusty. Furnish it with a workbench, a chair, a lamp and some shelves — and give something a splash of colour.

objectives.text: Gather 3 more wood
Furnish the workshop (B inside it)
Show Bram his workshop

offer: Um. Hi. You're the one who built the bridge, right? It's very… bridge-y. In a good way.
I was wondering… if you're not busy… could you help me set up my workshop again?
I need a workbench, a chair, a lamp, and a shelf or cabinet. And maybe… one thing in a bright colour? For courage.
accept: Really? Thank you! Here are some designs and a few materials. Arrange it however feels right — I trust you.
decline: Oh — of course. No pressure. I'll just… be here. With the dust.
progress: Workbench, chair, lamp, shelf, and something colourful. Press T in build mode to paint a piece!
complete: It's… it's perfect. I can already picture a coat rack shaped like a giraffe.
Here, take these designs — the fancy ones I never showed anyone. And these overalls, for real builders.

quests.title: Restore the Garden Fountain
quests.description: The plaza fountain is bone dry. Power a pump with a waterwheel in the mill channel, and pipe water to the fountain's inlet.

objectives.text: Dig 6 clay from the river bank (for pipes)
Mine some metal in the old quarry
Get water flowing into the fountain
Celebrate with Tilly

offer: You! Builder! Quick question: do you like water? Splashing? Fountains that actually fountain?
The plaza fountain used to be powered by the old mill channel next to my caravan. Waterwheel, gears, pump, pipes — gorgeous system. All gone now.
If you put a waterwheel in the channel, link it to a pump beside the water, and run pipes to the fountain's inlet on its east side… splish!
accept: Marvellous! Here are the machine designs and some metal. The blueprint glows in the plaza if you get stuck.
Pipes need clay — the river bank is full of it. And pumps need metal, from the quarry.
decline: It's only a little complicated! Like a sandwich with gears in it. Come back anytime.
progress: Power flows from the wheel through gear boxes and shafts. Water flows from a POWERED pump through pipes. Every connector has to line up!
complete: IT WORKS! Look at it! Water! Wet, glorious water!
You've got a real inventor's brain, you know. Here — my spare goggles, and some designs for fancy fountains and spark lamps.

quests.title: The Royal Decree
quests.description: Royal Decree No. 47 keeps the harbor sealed until the village reaches 120 Kingdom Harmony.

objectives.text: Raise Kingdom Harmony to 120 by helping the village
Petition Lord Percival to open the harbor

offer: Ahem! Citizen {name}! Your bridge has been noticed at the very highest levels. By me.
You may have heard: the harbor is sealed by Royal Decree Number Forty-Seven, until the kingdom is in Harmony once more.
Help the villagers, mend what is broken, and when Hearthglow's Harmony reaches one hundred and twenty, I shall lift the decree!
accept: Splendid! I shall prepare a ceremonial key. And a ceremonial key-holder. And a speech.
decline: Very well. The decree shall remain decreed.
progress: Harmony grows with every good deed. Check your Harmony with P — I find it very soothing.
complete: By the authority vested in me by… me… I hereby lift Royal Decree Number Forty-Seven!
The harbor is open! Do go and see — and take this sailor's outfit. Ceremonially.

quests.title: A Home of Your Own
quests.description: Lord Percival has granted you the empty plot beside the Lantern Inn. Build a little house there: walls, a door, a roof and a bed.

objectives.text: Build your home on the plot beside the inn: 3 walls, a door, a roof and a bed
Tell Lord Percival your home is ready

offer: Citizen {name}! A builder who mends bridges should not be sleeping above a soup kitchen forever.
By the powers vested in me, I grant you the empty plot beside the Lantern Inn. Build yourself a proper home. Four walls! Well, three will do. And a door, a roof and a bed.
I have drawn up the deed and some blueprints. And a few planks. The kingdom provides!
dialogue.declineLabel: The inn suits me for now
accept: Splendid! Build on the plot east of the inn. When it is done, come and tell me, and I shall make it official.
decline: As you wish. The deed shall wait, rolled up very neatly.
progress: Walls, a door, a roof and a bed. The Starforge Tool will show you what is still missing when you build on your plot.
complete: A house! With a roof and everything! I hereby declare it your official residence.
Sleep in your own bed whenever you like, and change your clothes at home. Welcome home, {name}.

quests.title: All Aboard!
quests.description: Captain Gale's ferry can't moor at the broken dock. Lay planks from the shore out to the mooring post.

objectives.text: Rebuild the dock out to the mooring post
Tell the Captain the dock is ready

offer: Ahoy there! You must be the builder everyone's singing about. Literally — Fern made up a song.
My ferry's been bobbing out in the bay for years. The dock's too broken to tie up to!
The old pilings still stand. Lay planks from the shore out to the mooring post and we'll be sailing by sundown!
accept: That's the spirit! Here's some timber from my hold.
decline: The sea will wait. It's very good at waiting. It's mostly what it does.
progress: Planks from the sand out to the mooring post, matey. The old pilings will hold them up.
complete: Would you look at that! A dock fit for a queen. Or a captain. Or a captain who is also a queen.
The ferry's ready. Hop aboard and I'll show you the islands — Clockwork Cove first!

quests.title: Shiny Stones for the Castle
quests.description: Lord Percival wants stone and a sparkling crystal to "restore the castle's dignity".

objectives.text: Mine 4 stone in the old quarry
Find a crystal (try the glowing blue rock)
Bring them to Lord Percival

offer: Citizen! A crisis of the GRAVEST order! The castle's decorative stonework is… slightly chipped.
Fetch me four stones and one shining crystal from the old quarry, west of the bakery. For the kingdom!
accept: Excellent! Strike the rocks when the ring lines up — I am told that is the technique.
decline: Only a LITTLE chipped? Next you'll tell me the moat is only a little puddle. …It is. But still!
progress: Four stones and a crystal, posthaste! Or slowhaste. Any haste.
complete: Magnificent! The castle shall gleam! I have prepared a small medal. It is a button. But it is a SHINY button.

quests.title: Squirrels in the Scones
quests.description: Three squirrels have moved into Mabel's bakery. Lure them back to the oak tree with acorns.

objectives.text: Shake the old oak by the bakery for acorns
Offer an acorn to each squirrel
Tell Mabel the bakery is clear

offer: Oh, could you help? The squirrels have made a nest in my flour sacks. Again!
They love acorns more than scones. If you shook the old oak and offered them some, I bet they'd scamper home.
accept: You're a dear! Gently, now — they're fluffy but dramatic.
decline: They ARE a bit scary. Especially the one with the tiny eyebrows.
progress: One acorn each, and they'll follow it right back to the oak.
complete: They're gone! Well — they're waving at me from the oak. Rude, but adorable.
Here, a proper chef's hat. You've earned it.

quests.title: Petals for the Plaza
quests.description: Fern wants to fill the village with flowers. Grow some in her garden beds.

objectives.text: Plant seeds in Fern's garden beds
Water the seedlings
Pick a fully grown bloom
Show Fern your flowers

offer: I have a wild idea. A WILD idea. What if the whole village was flowers?
Start small: plant some seeds in my garden beds, water them, and see what blooms!
accept: Here are some seeds. Talk to them while they grow — it helps. Probably.
decline: The seeds will wait. They're very good at that.
progress: Water them whenever the soil looks dry. They grow while you're off adventuring!
complete: They're gorgeous! You have the greenest thumbs. Here — my spare sun hat.

quests.title: A Fishy Tale
quests.description: Captain Gale bets you can't catch three fish. Prove him wrong.

objectives.text: Catch 3 fish (fishing spots by the river and harbor)
Show the Captain your catch

offer: Every sailor worth their salt can catch a fish. I once caught one THIS big! Well — this big. It shrank in the telling.
Catch me three, and I'll make you an honorary captain.
accept: Cast your line, wait for the bite, and keep the tension steady!
decline: Suit yourself! More fish for the fish.
progress: Steady on the reel — too much tension and SNAP!
complete: Three fine fish! By the seven seas, you're a natural. Here's your captain's hat, Captain {name}!

quests.title: Lost Starforge Notes
quests.description: Odessa hid her old notes in treasure chests and buried caches around the island. Find three of them.

objectives.text: Find 3 treasures (chests, or dig where the tool hums)
Return to Odessa

offer: When I was young and dramatic, I hid my notes all over the island. Chests, mostly. Some I buried.
Your tool hums when buried treasure is near — the louder it hums, the closer you are. Find three for me?
accept: Look behind the castle, near the quarry, and over in the orchard. And listen for that hum!
decline: They've waited forty years. They can wait a bit more.
progress: The hum gets warmer as you get closer. Press E to dig when it's practically singing.
complete: My old notes! Oh, look at my terrible handwriting. Thank you, dear. Take this backpack — every explorer needs one.

quests.title: Bright Ideas
quests.description: Tilly wants to see a Spark Lamp light up from your own power source.

objectives.text: Light a Spark Lamp with a waterwheel or windmill
Show Tilly your lamp

offer: Idea! Spark Lamps glow when they're powered. Power from a windmill, or a waterwheel, through shafts and gear boxes…
Build me one that lights up, anywhere you like!
accept: Brilliant! Get it? Brilliant? Because lamps? I'll stop.
decline: The idea will keep. Ideas are very shelf-stable.
progress: Source, shafts or gears, then lamp. Line up those connectors!
complete: Glowing! Beautiful! I'm going to stare at it until I see spots.
